import numpy as np

# Paper money in circulation data (in millions) from FY 1941 to FY 1950
data = [8932, 11600, 16492, 21438, 25511, 26945, 26942, 26182, 26034, 25661]

print("Data (FY 1941-1950):", data)
print("Number of observations (n):", len(data))

# Calculate unbiased sample Fisher excess Kurtosis
# Formula: g2 = [(n+1)*m4 - 3*(m2)^2] / ((n-1)*(n-2)*(s^2)^2) + 3*(n-1)^2/((n-2)*(n-3))
# Where m4 = 4th moment about mean, m2 = 2nd moment about mean (variance), s = standard deviation

n = len(data)
mean = np.mean(data)
print("Mean:", mean)

# Calculate m2 (variance using n, not n-1)
m2 = np.sum((np.array(data) - mean)**2) / n
print("m2 (variance about mean):", m2)

# Calculate m4 (4th moment about mean)
m4 = np.sum((np.array(data) - mean)**4) / n
print("m4 (4th moment about mean):", m4)

# Calculate s^2 (sample variance with n-1 denominator)
s2 = np.var(data, ddof=1)
print("Sample variance (s^2):", s2)

# Calculate unbiased sample Fisher excess Kurtosis
# g2 = ((n+1)*m4 - 3*m2^2) / ((n-1)*(n-2)*s2^2) + 3*(n-1)^2/((n-2)*(n-3))
numerator = (n+1)*m4 - 3*m2**2
denominator = (n-1)*(n-2)*s2**2
g2 = numerator / denominator + 3*(n-1)**2/((n-2)*(n-3))

print("\nUnbiased sample Fisher excess Kurtosis:", g2)
print("Rounded to thousandths:", round(g2, 3))
EOF
